body:
**Clause.** IEEE 802.1AS-2011 10.3.11, PortAnnounceInformation state machine (Figure 10-13, as corrected by Cor1). CURRENT goes to AGED when `currentTime >= syncReceiptTimeoutTime && gmPresent`, as well as on announce receipt timeout. syncReceiptTimeout is 3 Sync intervals (10.6.3.1). Milan v1.2 Table 4.2 gives 375 ms (tolerance 337.5-562.5 ms), and the engine's own value is 375 ms.

**Observed** at `55680bff`. A better grandmaster on the test machine keeps sending Announce while its Sync stops, or its Sync/Follow_Up pairs become unusable:
- no Follow_Up;
- Follow_Up after the next Sync;
- Follow_Up with sequenceId + 1.

The end station keeps deferring for the whole 2.3-5 s window. It takes over only about 3 s after the last Announce, on announce receipt timeout.

**Source.** `hdl/ucode/gen_gptp_ucode.py:1361-1362` maps timer slot 4 (sync receipt) to SRTO. `prog_leg_srto` (`:1997-2016`) only clears `FL_SYNCOK`. Only slot 2 (announce receipt) reaches BECGATE (`:1357-1358`).

**Expected.** On sync receipt timeout with gmPresent, the port's information ages and BMCA re-runs, as on announce receipt timeout.

**Acceptance.**
- A test with Announce continuing and Sync stopped: the end station takes over as grandmaster within syncReceiptTimeout plus one BMCA pass.
- The same for each unusable Sync/Follow_Up shape.
- A plant that restores flag-only handling is caught.
- After the fix, re-check that Sync every 250 ms keeps the end station deferring, and that a Follow_Up 60 ms after its Sync is used. Both pass today only because the end station never ages on sync loss.

comments.body:
[A10] **Assignment, executor [A689].** Owner, 2026-10-27: no qualification failure is acceptable. This is release work.

On main `55680bff`, IEEE 802.1AS-2011 (+Cor1/Cor2) 10.3.11, PortAnnounceInformation (Figure 10-13): CURRENT goes to AGED when `currentTime >= syncReceiptTimeoutTime && gmPresent`.
1. On sync receipt timeout with gmPresent, the port's information ages and BMCA re-runs, exactly as on announce receipt timeout. Today timer slot 4 only clears FL_SYNCOK (`hdl/ucode/gen_gptp_ucode.py:1361-1362`, `prog_leg_srto` `:1997-2016`), and only slot 2 reaches BECGATE (`:1357-1358`). Fix this through the generator. syncReceiptTimeout stays 3 × the Sync interval (10.6.3.1; Milan v1.2 Table 4.2).
2. **Tests:**
   - Announce continuing while Sync stops: the end station becomes grandmaster within syncReceiptTimeout plus one BMCA pass.
   - The same for each unusable Sync/Follow_Up shape: no Follow_Up, a late Follow_Up, and a sequenceId mismatch.
   - Sync every 250 ms keeps the end station deferring.
   - A Follow_Up 60 ms after its Sync is used.
   - A mutant restoring flag-only handling is caught by a named check.
3. Mind the automatic grandmaster recovery requirement (the GM must recover automatically). An aged port must not oscillate while Sync recovers.
4. **Gates:** as #90's lane: the full gate set, plus the milan-fpga consumer gates including the `milan_dp` `gptp`/`gptp-lat` legs.

STOP on any top-level port, parameter or register-map change.

[A10] Change of plan: #89, #90 and #91 all change the generated microcode (`hdl/ucode/gen_gptp_ucode.py` and its generated output), so they go in ONE lane to avoid regenerated-file conflicts. Executor [A688] takes this issue's assignment above (issuecomment-6434676256) together with #90/#91's; there is no [A689].

title: Sync receipt timeout does not age the port's information or re-run BMCA (802.1AS-2011 10.3.11, Figure 10-13)
